title: Service Worker Shields-Down Over-Blocking
description: Tests whether service-worker requests are wrongly blocked when Shields are down for a site. A tracker URL on Brave's default lists is requested from the page and from a service worker, via fetch() (brave-browser#34107) and via importScripts() (brave-browser#35461). With Shields down, a buggy build blocks the worker request because it loses tab_origin, while the same page request is allowed; when fixed, all four are allowed. With Shields up, all are correctly blocked.
